title: Hardship Settlement Rate Card: Large and Mid Balance Reductions
content:
# Hardship Settlement — Balance Reductions

Rate card of Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements for the Hardship Settlement, read from the balance due on the Placed Consumer Accounts record on the offer date.

**Rate rule.** Where the account's balance due on the offer date is 4000.00 dollars or more, the Hardship Settlement large-balance reduction of 1.0 point applies; where it is at least 1500.00 dollars but under 4000.00 dollars, the Hardship Settlement mid-balance reduction of 0.5 points applies; a balance due under 1500.00 dollars carries no balance reduction for a Hardship Settlement.

| Balance due on the offer date | Reduction |
|---|---|
| 4000.00 dollars or more | 1.0 percentage point |
| 1500.00 to 3999.99 dollars | 0.5 percentage points |
| under 1500.00 dollars | none |

Hypothetical edges: 4000.00 dollars takes 1.0 point and 3999.99 dollars takes 0.5; 1500.00 dollars takes 0.5 and 1499.99 dollars takes none. The bands never stack.
